TABLE.NAME: enrol_conditional_state
TABLE.COMMENT: Actions taken by the plugin when the conditions of an enrolment stopped being met. Only enrolments suspended by the plugin, recorded here, can be reactivated by it.

FIELD.NAME: action
FIELD.COMMENT: Action taken: none (only recorded) or suspend.

FIELD.NAME: reason
FIELD.COMMENT: Conditions not met, as plain text.

FIELD.NAME: timesuspended
FIELD.COMMENT: When the plugin acted (suspended, or recorded the failure when the action is none).

FIELD.NAME: uetimemodified
FIELD.COMMENT: timemodified of the user enrolment right after the plugin acted, updated when someone else only changes the dates of a suspended enrolment. A different value means the enrolment was changed without events.

FIELD.NAME: timereactivated
FIELD.COMMENT: When the plugin reactivated the enrolment.

FIELD.NAME: timeclosed
FIELD.COMMENT: When this record stopped applying. Null while open.

FIELD.NAME: closereason
FIELD.COMMENT: Why it was closed: reactivated, met, external or superseded.
